tables.notes: Columns (text unless noted): craa5_name ("sampleid | description"), craa5_sampleid, craa5_sampledescription, craa5_testmethod, craa5_rawresult, craa5_collectiondate (YYYY-MM-DD plant day), craa5_result (positive/negative/pending/count/replaced; count = lab number with no pass or fail, replaced = superseded row, never deleted), craa5_test, craa5_stage, craa5_sitecode, craa5_swabzone, craa5_area, craa5_room, craa5_sapw, craa5_equipmentguid, craa5_assettag, craa5_surface, craa5_closedkey, craa5_closedon (YYYY-MM-DD), craa5_source. Row id = hubIdFromKey("swab|" + sampleid + "|" + description + "|" + test) (BOLO v2.3: one row per test, so Listeria and Salmonella from one sponge are two rows). Open hits: craa5_result eq positive and craa5_closedkey null and statecode eq 0 and craa5_collectiondate ge (today - alertMonths from PATHOGEN_BOLO_RULES, default 2 months); older positives are history, never looked up for closure. Closed by ANY MSS log row of the same equipment GUID (or same area when the site has no equipment) with shift date on or after the collection date (Gerald 2026-10-23: every clean follows the presumptive process). Results: > or TNTC readings on APC, ATP, coliform, yeast/mold = positive; EST is wording only (2,500 EST = 2500). count = a lab number: a pass in APC and ATP rates, in no rate elsewhere (Listeria, Salmonella). replaced is skipped everywhere.
